hero_headline: Best Cafés & Lunch Spots Near *Uptown Waterloo*
hero_meta: A local's guide to coffee and lunch around the office
intro_paragraph: One of the best perks of working from a coworking space in Uptown Waterloo? You're surrounded by some of the city’s best cafés and local lunch spots. Whether you're stepping out for a mid-morning coffee, taking a client to lunch, or just grabbing something quick between meetings, there's no shortage of delicious options just steps from Den 1880.
